<!-- energy:question-14:start -->
## 14. Can the bag be picked up and released at this scale?

What cable, winch and control measurements would quantify pickup loads and pendulum motion? How much station-keeping power is missing under a beam wind?

## What this model leaves out

These plans close only in the quasi-static force-and-bus model. Vertical dynamics, suspended-load control and sufficient stored energy for mission completion remain unestablished. Rotor energy and power figures are conditional on a constant hover merit times drive efficiency at every thrust and speed, with no separate blade profile power and no specified blade, rotor-speed or pitch policy. A separated model can move these figures in either direction.

Generated by `node research/analysis/energy-omissions.mjs`. These loads are not silently absorbed into a closing claim.

| Class | Beam-wind side force, t | Cable mass, t (floor / credible / demonstrated) | Battery mass, t (same cases) | Dry target, t | Bag, t | Cable, m | Pendulum period, s | Day-average solar, MW |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| P100 | 29.709 | 0.644 / 1.431 / 2.146 | 40.000 / 66.667 / 134.228 | 100 | 125 | 350 | 37.530 | 0.207 |
| P1000 | 139.077 | 11.036 / 24.525 / 36.788 | 240.000 / 400.000 / 805.369 | 1000 | 1250 | 600 | 49.138 | 0.967 |
| P10000 | 643.635 | 155.096 / 344.658 / 516.987 | 4000.000 / 6666.667 / 13422.819 | 10000 | 12400 | 850 | 58.486 | 4.476 |

| Class | Design displacement, m³ | Geometric capsule, m³ | Difference from design, % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| P100 | 220000.000 | 217784.366 | -1.007 |
| P1000 | 2200000.000 | 2205867.973 | 0.267 |
| P10000 | 22000000.000 | 21961324.389 | -0.176 |

Buoyancy uses the declared design displacement. The capsule comparison is a geometry difference, not a change to lift or the class constants.

The beam wind is 10 m/s, with an unverified side-drag coefficient of 1 and local source density. No horizontal actuator or station-keeping power is priced.

Cable and battery estimates bind to `research/analysis/mass-budget.json`. Cable mass is not added to the energy model's dry target.

Storage cases use 500, 300, 149 Wh/kg, respectively. Their source qualifications remain in the mass-budget record.

The bag is a moving pendulum; its ideal small-angle period is shown, but swing, damping and winch transients are unpriced. The steady hoist bill does not bound pickup shock.

Solar is credited at its day average at every instant, including night. Dry mass is a target equal to payload, not an assembled mass ledger; see [the float analysis](../float/).
<!-- energy:question-14:end -->

requirements.existing_boundary: Anchor reach, achieved bag inventory and quasi-static support/steady hoist are represented. Cable reach is not immersion or pickup-load evidence; pickup shock is not bounded by the steady hoist bill.
prospective_observations: Matched hull, attachment, cable, winch, bag and water configuration; wet/dry load-transfer force/moment and motion histories, drum payout/retrieval, tension/slack and immersion/clearance
requirements.prospective_custodian_role: Pickup load-path and winch evidence custodians
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: A reachable cable, bag capacity, prescribed winch speed or steady hoist energy does not establish dynamic pickup loads or qualified transfer.

requirements.existing_boundary: The printed ideal small-angle pendulum period is an existing diagnostic. Swing, damping and winch transients are unpriced; a period is not a coupled controlled response.
prospective_observations: Matched hull and bag position/attitude histories, cable angle/tension, payout state, disturbance history and damping/control response
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: The ideal period or static force balance cannot establish stable swing, damping, tracking or disturbance rejection.

requirements.existing_boundary: The fixed choreography is checked quasi-statically, not integrated as observed vertical dynamics. Unsupported instants refuse the plan; source failure/UNKNOWN records remain.
prospective_observations: Command/measurement timestamps, sensor and actuator configuration, directional force/moment limits, response delay/rate and saturation, control history and disturbance/load state
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: A prescribed trajectory or model closure does not establish a controller, observed dynamics, safe transients or fail-safe operation.

requirements.existing_boundary: The published beam-wind side force uses a stipulated wind and unverified side-drag coefficient with local density. No horizontal actuator or station-keeping power is priced. A force diagnostic is not available horizontal power.
prospective_observations: Matched wind/air state and hull orientation, local flow, horizontal actuator force/moment and electrical power histories, competing loads and control response
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: A side-force table, vertical rotor bus or solar day-average cannot establish horizontal authority/power or station keeping.

requirements.existing_boundary: Printed cable/battery policies and the dry-equals-payload target do not qualify an installed pickup system. The existing material-strength crosswalk is separate; no repetition or cable/control selection occurs here.
prospective_observations: Complete matched test configuration and source revision, calibration, uncertainty, disturbance envelope, independent evidence and proposed physical criterion with responsible assignment
requirements.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; no new numeric threshold selected
requirements.disconfirming_or_insufficient_evidence: Component strength, favourable assumptions or a differently scaled configuration cannot substitute for complete matched dynamics/control evidence.

evidence_boundaries: Quasi-static force/bus closure, ideal omission diagnostics and observed dynamics are distinct evidence classes.
Existing cable/battery/geometry/solar quantities and known failures are retained verbatim, without table regeneration or load/power calculation.
No cable/control policy, trajectory, safety case or fail-safe conclusion is selected.
Physical criteria and owner appointments remain UNKNOWN/UNASSIGNED; no solver, campaign or field action occurs.
